source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if power LED works normally
1. Press power bottom and check power LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. LED working mode need to match SPEC • Off = No AC, system off• Blue = Powered on

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: ipmitool chassis power (agent) + person for LED observation
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Power LED: requires powering the system on/off to observe the LED color. Agent can power the SUT on/off via `ipmitool chassis power` and read power state, but the LED color must be observed by a person at the machine.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the power-state change + LED color/blink observed by the operator at each power state so user confirms it matches SPEC.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: powering the SUT on/off affects availability; confirm the SUT is free.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical chassis power LED follows the platform specification across the source-defined unpowered/off and powered-on conditions, including blue indication when on.
original_method: An engineer uses the physical power button and observes/photographs the chassis LED; the stated criterion also references a no-AC/system-off condition that must be resolved against the project LED specification.
manual_activity: The source requires pressing the chassis power button and judging physical LED color/state. If the no-AC condition is included, a person must also perform the approved physical AC removal/restoration; an IPMI off is not equivalent to absence of AC.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/board revision and power-LED location
Complete LED color, steady/blink and transition timing specification
Whether 'Off = No AC, system off' is one or two required states
Maintenance window, workload drain, physical access and OOB recovery
Approved final power/AC state and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not press the button or remove AC while jobs, storage writes or dependent services are active.
Do not replace the physical-button requirement with IPMI or replace a specified no-AC state with software power-off.
Use the normal button behavior; hard-off or prolonged press requires separate explicit approval.
Stop on unexpected boot/power behavior and do not repeat transitions automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Capture read-only BMC power and health state before/after each engineer-observed condition.
Organize timestamped operator photos and correlate them with power/AC state and the exact LED specification.
Report discrepancies without claiming visual observation or formal PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve the required off/no-AC states and approve the transition plan.
Operate the physical button and, if required by the resolved criterion, the AC cord; visually observe the LED.
Compare the physical evidence with the platform specification and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool chassis power status is useful correlation, but an ipmitool power transition cannot prove the physical-button behavior, LED appearance or an AC-absent condition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only BMC power status and event timestamps as supporting evidence only. Do not issue remote power off/on unless the approved project plan adds it without substituting the source action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The physical button, off/no-AC and blue/on criteria and 5/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a state matrix that distinguishes AC absent, AC present/S5 and S0, then collect one timestamped photo per required state with simultaneous BMC power/health evidence. Execute only the states approved from the source criterion.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, front-panel assembly and firmware/power policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board revision, BMC/BIOS versions and LED specification revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner platform front-panel LED and safe power-operation specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes ambiguous power states explicit and improves traceability without replacing visual inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; physical button and any confirmed no-AC requirement remain manual.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED state matrix and safe transitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC state cannot verify emitted color or AC absence.

project_override_considerations: The project may define which off state is in scope. If physical AC absence is selected, that is a case-specific manual step; ED-32 is not generalized to unrelated AC-cycle cases. A reduced plan must explicitly record which source state was not executed.
expected_evidence: Platform/LED spec, resolved state matrix, SUT identity, maintenance approval and final-state plan
Timestamped photos showing the identified LED in each required state
Operator record of physical button and any explicitly required AC action
Correlated BMC power/health, SEL/UEFI evidence and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source does not state opposing LED outcomes, but its compact criterion ambiguously joins 'No AC' and 'system off' while the procedure only names a button press. This is a readiness/coverage clarification, not yet a proven contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The LED observation intent is clear and manually executable after the state matrix and safe transitions are confirmed. Missing specification detail is not permanent blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain BMC correlation but reject remote power control as a substitute for the physical-button/no-AC semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its maintenance/recovery controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly isolates the ambiguous no-AC versus system-off coverage without inventing a transition.

review_improvement: Adds a three-state power/AC interpretation check and preserves physical action provenance, preventing a blue/on observation plus IPMI off from falsely satisfying the complete criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: LED color is a visual physical property and the source explicitly names a physical button. Supporting BMC telemetry cannot perform or prove those core actions. The criterion's no-AC wording requires a project clarification, but the case remains MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED.
